title: Reflect

items.say: Hi. I'm Lumi. This one is just three short lines about your day.
text: One good thing, one thing that changes from day to day, and one thing for tomorrow.
Writing a small thing down helps you notice it. Good moments are easy to walk past, and a plan for tomorrow is lighter on paper than in your head.
A few words is plenty. Skip any line you like. What you write is kept on this device, and nobody else reads it. With sync on, it is encrypted before it leaves.

tip: Rather talk? Tap the mic on your keyboard.
